product_name: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory (arXiv:2501.13956)
primary_use_cases: Bi-temporal fact storage for agents; invalidate stale facts; enterprise memory with compliance-friendly history
integration_model: Episode ingestion → fact extraction → temporal graph queries
graph_model: Core contribution: facts as edges/nodes with valid_from, valid_to, invalid_at
extraction_approach: LLM extracts facts and entities from conversational episodes
update_operations: Invalidate prior facts when contradicted; add new valid edges
consolidation_strategy: Roll up episodes; maintain valid fact set over time
temporal_model: First-class bi-temporal model — primary differentiator vs flat vector memory
retrieval_signals: Graph traversal constrained by validity + semantic search
latency_profile: Claims <200ms and large enterprise latency reductions
token_efficiency: Compact fact context vs full transcripts
framework_integrations: Compared in Mem0 paper as memory platform baseline
benchmark_methodology: DMR 94.8%; LongMemEval; enterprise task latency studies
stated_unsolved_problems: Graph operational cost; extraction quality on noisy dialogues
memorable_should_port: C2: valid_from, valid_to, invalidated_at, superseded_by_id on SQL memories
